question: In Table 2.2-1 (Project Life Cycle Phases, PDF Page 19), compare the Purpose and Typical Outcomes of Pre-Phase A (Concept Studies) versus Phase A (Concept and Technology Development).
answer: Pre-Phase A (Pre-Formulation) produces a broad spectrum of ideas/alternatives to determine feasibility and scope, yielding feasible system concepts (simulations, analysis, study reports, models, mock-ups). Phase A (Formulation) determines feasibility/desirability of a suggested new system and establishes an initial baseline compatible with NASA strategic plans, yielding system concept definition and trade study definition.

question: According to the table on PDF Page 25 (SE 2.0 Product Realization), what is the difference between SE 2.4 (Product Validation) and SE 2.5 (Product Transition)?
